name: Australia
summary: Australian band names from the ACMA spectrum plan, 433 MHz tyre sensors and fobs, km/h, and Australian plate-reader signatures. In testing with drivers in Australia: expect mislabels and report them.
notes: Speed-measuring devices are not detected in this region: radar and speed-camera detectors are prohibited in most Australian states, so rules for speed-enforcement makers are switched off.
Band names come from the ACMA spectrum plan. A frequency the pack does not name shows as a plain carrier rather than a US label.
Remote ID is not mandated in Australia, so fewer drones announce themselves; DJI's own broadcast still works.
